description: Resolve a pending gate. A policy gate takes an outcome: approved (proceed), revised (stay in phase), killed (abandon feature). An owner gate (id owner:<qid>, from get_pending_gates) is the owner's open question: it takes `option` (one of its options[].key) and is closed in the owner queue with owner_queue.py close --channel mcp --if-version (first answer wins: OWNER_GATE_STALE when it was answered or re-asked since, OWNER_GATE_OPTION for a key it does not have); the tool then mints a log receipt on the closed line and returns its evidence_id. Only a session on the allow list (default s1-chat; `ownerGateSessions` in .compose/compose.json; named by COMPOSE_SESSION_NAME) may answer an owner gate: any other session is refused with OWNER_GATE_SESSION and nothing is written.

evidence.description: Required when a policy gate outcome is approved (an approval claims the gated work is done); not read for revised, killed or an owner gate (that receipt is minted by the tool after the close). Receipt for the claim, re-checked by the server (contracts/evidence.schema.json): an object {kind, at (ISO time), by (session), ...kind fields} with kind sha {repo, sha, branch? (a land_branches name, e.g. "2.0")} | process {pid, launched_at, label, exit_file?, log?} (checked at launch + 120 s or later) | file {path, line?} | log {path, line} | screenshot {path, region?} | command {command, output_line, log} | pixel {path, point {x, y}, expected "#rrggbb"}; or an "ev:<id>" from `node lib/evidence-cli.js record`. Refused without one (EVIDENCE_REQUIRED) unless the workspace sets capabilities.evidence false. The accepted id comes back as evidence_id.

gateId.description: Gate ID (a policy gate id, or owner:<qid> for an owner question)

option.description: Owner gate only: the chosen options[].key

outcome.description: Resolution outcome of a policy gate (required for one; not read for an owner gate)

version.description: Owner gate only, optional: the gate version get_pending_gates returned; a re-asked question is refused OWNER_GATE_STALE

name: approve_gate
